subject: Is it possible to display every nth error bar?

messages.author: 539b802f2724c2df
messages.subject: Is it possible to display every nth error bar?
parts:
I'm building a line graph and adding error bars to it.  Currently, my (simplified) code looks like this:

ggplot(df,aes(time,S,color=Sex))
     +geom_point()
     +geom_errorbar(aes(x=time,ymin=S-Err,ymax=S+Err))

And everything works as expected. 

The only problem is that my dependent variable (S) is sampled at about 200 values of the dependent variable (time), and having 200 error bars makes the graph unreadable.  Is there a way to just display every (say...) tenth error bar?  It seems like there should be a simple trick I'm not thinking of. 

Many thanks for any thoughts you might have.
Geoff

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to display every nth error bar?
parts:
Hi,

is this what you want?

df <- data.frame(
time=rep(1:100, 2),
S=sin(rep(1:100, 2)*pi/50) + rnorm(200, 0, 0.1),
Sex=gl(2,100),
Err=rnorm(200,0,0.2))

ggplot(df,aes(time,S,color=Sex)) +
geom_point() +
geom_errorbar(aes(x=time,ymin=S-Err,ymax=S+Err), data=df[seq(1,
nrow(df), 10),])

the trick is to pass the reduced data to geom_errorbar by
data=df[seq(1, nrow(df), 10),]
